_note: 學習路徑內容第20批 #6／6：情態 + 完成式 modal perfect（eng.t_adv.modal.perfect，學測級／高階）。情態助動詞 + have + 過去分詞表過去：must have + p.p.＝對過去的肯定推測（It must have rained.）；should have + p.p.＝後悔/責備過去該做而未做（I should have studied.）；may/might/could have + p.p.＝對過去的不確定推測（She might have left.）；can't/couldn't have + p.p.＝確定過去沒發生（He can't have taken it.）。誘答鎖『用原形取代過去分詞／用簡單式取代完成式／語意相反的情態（must↔should↔can't）／助動詞後接 has』等唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix mpf_）。

units.title_zh: 情態 + 完成式（must／should／might have + 過去分詞）
units.can_do: 我能用『情態助動詞 + have + 過去分詞』談過去：must have 表對過去的肯定推測、should have 表後悔／該做而未做、might/could have 表不確定推測、can't have 表確定沒發生。
units.situation_group: 情態助動詞：情態＋完成式
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'must have + past participle' expresses a confident conclusion about the past: 'The ground is wet; it must have rained.'
claims.verification_ref: must have + 過去分詞＝對過去的肯定推測（The ground is wet; it must have rained）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'should have + past participle' expresses regret or criticism about a past action that did not happen (or should not have happened): 'I should have studied harder.' (but I didn't).
claims.verification_ref: should have + 過去分詞＝後悔/責備過去該做而未做（I should have studied harder，但我沒有）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'may/might/could have + past participle' expresses a past possibility when we are not sure: 'She might have forgotten.'
claims.verification_ref: may/might/could have + 過去分詞＝對過去不確定的推測（She might have forgotten）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'can't / couldn't have + past participle' expresses certainty that something did not happen: 'He can't have taken it; he was with me.'
claims.verification_ref: can't/couldn't have + 過去分詞＝確定過去沒發生（He can't have taken it; he was with me）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 'must have + past participle' is a confident guess about the past: you are almost sure it happened. The lights are off; they must have gone to bed.
teach.zh_hint: must have + 過去分詞＝對過去的肯定推測。

teach.body: The lights are off; they must have gone to bed.
teach.zh_hint: 燈都關了，他們一定是去睡了。must have gone＝肯定推測。

teach.body: 'should have + past participle' shows regret or criticism - the right thing was not done. I should have brought my umbrella. (but I didn't)
teach.zh_hint: should have + 過去分詞＝後悔／該做而未做。

teach.body: I should have brought my umbrella.
teach.zh_hint: 我當初該帶傘的——但我沒帶。should have brought＝後悔。

teach.body: 'might/could have' = a past possibility (not sure); 'can't have' = sure it did NOT happen. She isn't here; she might have left early.
teach.zh_hint: might/could have＝不確定推測；can't have＝確定沒發生。

teach.body: She isn't here; she might have left early.
teach.zh_hint: 她不在，她可能提早離開了。might have left＝不確定的推測。

practice.stem: 選正確：The street is wet. It ____ last night.（街道是濕的，昨晚一定下過雨）

distractor_rationales.must rain: 對過去的肯定推測要用 must have + 過去分詞，不用原形。
distractor_rationales.must have rain: have 後面要用過去分詞 rained，不是原形 rain。
distractor_rationales.must raining: 時態錯誤；推測過去用 must have rained。

practice.feedback: It must have rained：must have + 過去分詞表對過去的肯定推測。

practice.stem: 選正確：I failed the test. I ____ harder.（我考差了，我當初應該更用功的——後悔）

distractor_rationales.should study: 表『過去該做而沒做』的後悔要用 should have + 過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.should have study: have 後面要用過去分詞 studied，不是原形 study。
distractor_rationales.must have studied: must have 表『一定做過』的推測，與『該做卻沒做』的後悔語意相反。

practice.feedback: I should have studied harder：should have + 過去分詞表後悔／該做而未做。

practice.stem: 選正確：He ____ the keys; he never had them.（他不可能拿了鑰匙，他根本沒拿過）

distractor_rationales.can't take: 對過去的否定推測要用 can't have + 過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.must have taken: must have 表『一定拿過』，與『不可能拿過』語意相反。
distractor_rationales.can't have took: have 後面要用過去分詞 taken，不是 took。

practice.feedback: He can't have taken…：can't have + 過去分詞表確定過去沒發生。

practice.stem: 選出正確的句子：（表對過去的不確定推測）
practice.answer: She might have missed the bus.
options: She might have missed the bus.
She might miss the bus yesterday.
She might have missing the bus.
She might has missed the bus.

yesterday 是過去，推測過去要用 might have + 過去分詞。
have 後面要用過去分詞 missed，不是 missing。
情態助動詞後一律用 have（不用 has）。

practice.feedback: She might have missed the bus：might have + 過去分詞表不確定的過去推測。

practice.stem: 'You should have called me.' 這句話的意思最接近？
practice.answer: 你當初應該打給我（但你沒有）
options: 你當初應該打給我（但你沒有）
你可以打給我，也可以不打

distractor_rationales.你現在必須打給我: should have called 指過去該做而未做，不是現在的義務。
distractor_rationales.你一定打過給我了: 那是 must have called（對過去的肯定推測）的意思。
distractor_rationales.你可以打給我，也可以不打: 那比較像 could call 的意思，不是 should have called 的後悔／責備。

practice.feedback: should have called＝過去該做卻沒做的後悔／責備。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: They must have forgotten about the meeting.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：must have forgotten（have + 過去分詞）、about、meeting、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。情態詞稍重、have 輕讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: You should have told me the truth.
lines.intonation: should 稍重、句尾 truth 下收

lines.text: She must have been very tired.
lines.intonation: must 稍重、句尾 tired 下收
